iti smṛtidānaṃ |

jauṣyāsurete itinaśvirāya |
vidhānāmakiśora ādipuruṣastadat sutaḥ śaṅkaraḥ
putrī matimān tasyālavaṃśocitaḥ |
tatputrībharataḥ sacemamatanocintāmaṇiṃ mudrayā
vāṇādvivibhūtiṃ bhakanṛpā'śodhayadyatnataḥ |
śrībharatacandramā |
